Chibi 3 heads tall pixel art sprite in Nippon Ichi Disgaea style, bold black outline, flat colors with two-step cel shading. A young lumberjack girl apprentice with a friendly cheerful look. Black shorts with a wide brown leather belt and a large square brass buckle, a round brass gauge and a wrench on her right hip, a small brown leather pouch with a brass gear on her left hip. One long black thigh sock on her left leg only with a brass gear garter strap, the right leg bare. Brown leather lace-up boots with brass gear buckles.
Weapon: a huge oversized two-handed black iron axe much taller than her, resting on her right shoulder and held in her right hand. A single wide black iron blade on one side with a riveted brass edge band and a short spike on the back, a very large polished brass gear at the eye of the axe with a glowing green gem set in its center, a straight black iron haft wrapped with green cord and brass bands, and a heavy brass counterweight cap at the bottom end.
